phone.notes: The Digimon World Championship cards are taken out of the game for now, and the app removes them from your list and the Dex. Sending in custom DIM cards is closed for now. Settings has a new What's new screen. If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: The watch face can show the data you choose (date, heart rate, battery...) and has a new plate. The steps past the daily limit of the tamer now give coins (from the server). If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports.

phoneStore.notes: Digimon World Championship cards are taken out of the game until it is balanced (Digimon you already raised from them stay). Custom DIM requests are closed for now. New What's new screen in Settings. If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports. Requires Android 13 or newer.
